events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Still burning bright. On this day, we remember the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who left us far too soon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: That iconic cover, that incredible tracklist. 'Abbey Road' still sounds as fresh today as it did on its release.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Still rocking and ruling the airwaves. Happy 75th to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde!

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis legend Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Still Wonderwalling. Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: A timeless message of peace and hope. On this day in 1971, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'.

events.title: The first iPod was released
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the original iPod, changing portable music forever.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The revolutionary first iPod arrived on this day. How many songs did you fit on yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today is James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', which premiered in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day Angle
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Imagine all the music. On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: From silly walks to faulty towers, a master of British comedy. Happy 87th to John Cleese!

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty tracks of pure genius. The 'White Album' dropped on this day in '68, and music was never the same.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the incomparable Freddie Mercury passed away at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: The show must go on, and his legacy certainly does. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A pivotal album that saw The Beatles push new boundaries. 'Rubber Soul' arrived on this day.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world lost music icon John Lennon at the age of 40.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: His music and message continue to inspire. Remembering John Lennon today, on the anniversary of his tragic passing.
